ORB with the defaults on the 512 x 512 test images. The last column is the share of keypoints found again after the image is turned a quarter counterclockwise: within 1 pixel of the turned place, with a radius within 10 percent, and with an angle 90 degrees larger, within 5 degrees. A quarter turn moves pixels exactly onto pixels, so any loss comes from the detector itself.
